summary.text: Gregg Amore is the incumbent Democratic Secretary of State, seeking a second term unopposed. A former East Providence high school history teacher and athletic director and a former state representative, he has declined a U.S. Justice Department demand for Rhode Island's unredacted voter file, a dispute now on appeal.

paragraphs.text: Amore graduated from East Providence High School in 1984, earned a bachelor's degree in history from Providence College in 1988 and received a master's degree in public policy from New England College in 2010.
He taught at East Providence High School and served as athletic director for the East Providence School Department before holding elected office.
Amore represented House District 65 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives from 2013 to 2023.
He has been Rhode Island Secretary of State since January 3, 2023, and launched his re-election campaign in March 2026 with labor and Democratic leaders at his side.

sources.title: Flanked by labor and Democratic leaders, RI Secretary of State Gregg Amore kicks off reelection bid
DOJ orders Amore to preserve 2024 election records in ongoing voter data fight
